# Purple Left Mod

A Minecraft Fabric mod that adds:
- Purple tint to the left half of the screen
- Glowing effect for mobs on the left side

## Installation
1. Download the JAR from the Actions tab
2. Place it in your Minecraft `mods` folder
3. Launch Minecraft with Fabric mod loader

## Building
This repository uses GitHub Actions to automatically build the mod.
Check the Actions tab for build artifacts.
